content: Sanhedrin4:0 Sanhedrin cawh, Juda mingphing uhnah naw a hnuipaw khongsil a cang. hme letah Piter le Johan
Tlangbui sahlo le behnah ing a vaipaw raekeh sahlo aa buipaw le Sadusi sahlo cawh Piter le Johan tah zawpui sahlo letei bia aa rei leimeining taco aaning khatah a vong he.
Aaning sahlo cawh aa thing a ae ngetei, zecawtamaw tatah apostol sahlo tei zawpui aa cawngpahnah rawng he tah le Zisu thihnah taitah a thokawnah kong khah aa y khui rong tah a cang.
Piter le Johan cawh tle he ka, zailang a cang thah cawtah thong letah a ningthlamongpaw tai aa chia he.
Canghrasala aa bia reipaw a thuipaw mehlupui taco zing he ka, zingtu cawngsaw 5000 tai a tah myca he.
A ningthlamongpaw leco nawhnuitu sahlo le macang sahlo le phungbia cawngpahtu sahlo cawh Jerusalem leco a pahmo he.
Tlangbui alaicaipaw Anas zong ung hrah ka, Kaiafa le Johan le Alekzandar le ahringpaw tlangbui alaicaipaw a ingchungkho cawngsaw sahlo zong a ung hrah he.
Piter le Johan cawh ma sahlo aa hmekung leco va chuakhui he ka, “Ze hmingtuakhyná tamaw a cang ly leh aho ming tamaw ma hming heh naa tua?” tatah aa hae rahry he.
Mataico Piter cawh Thlawpaw Pathai tah chih ka, aa hai letaco, “Zawpui cung letah nawhnuitu le macang sahlo!
A phesongpaw cung letei ningdonah kaa palangsahnah kong letah atoning heh ma hrahei ma y he ceh ka, zehratamaw dangnah a hmuh tahpaw kong heh naa ma hae.

Naaning kha Israel cawngsaw vytei khatah ma heh hnih my lo. Naa hme letei a daw thlangpaw cawngsawpaw heh naaning tah khraws letah khaipai he ceh ka tei, Khazing tei thihnah taitah a patho kawpaw Nazaret Zisu Khri ming tah a dangpaw a cang hi.
Ama cawh,

content.text: ‘ing a sahtu sahlo tah aa hlawhpaw a lung,
ingkilung a biapui caipaw khah a cang.’

content: Pachahnah cawh aho letah hmai hmuh khy cang be. Aluicung pungpaluh lehei kaaning pachahnah rua pawtah ming hringpaw ung be,” tatah a tah.

Piter le Johan aa raechah zia cawh hmuh he ka, cawngsaw cakhawngpaw le ca a thai lypaw aa cangpaw khah aa hni tihtah aaning sahlo cawh aa khuarawha ka, Zisu kha a ungteipaw a cang he tahpaw aa hni he.
Canghrasala a dangsahpaw cawngsawpaw cawh Piter le Johan kha a daw thlangpaw aa hmuh tihtah zekhatahmai aa rei khy nápaw ung be.
Macawtaco Piter le Johan cawh Sanhedrin taikhei piakhui law tah he ka, mataico aaning sahlo cawh a pahmo he ka, bia aa reisia.
Aaning tah, “Ma cawngsaw sahlo heh zekhatamaw kaa tua he a? Jerusalem letei a ungpaw vytei tahei hmingchaw ningang chuipaw aa tua tahpaw aa hni thlu thah myca, cang be tah khy tlung bei he peh.
Canghrasala ma kong heh cawngsaw hrong letah a kaipaza vy ly nápawtah Zisu ming hei bia rei khaw bei ceh tatah raering kaa pae he a,” tatah aa tah.
Macawtaco apostol pahning tlaw cawh y kaw he ka, Zisu ming tah bia reilai tah cawngpah hrahring khaw bei ceh, tatah bia aa patai he.
Canghrasala Piter le Johan taco, “Naaning tah pacang tua la, Khazing mehmuh letah naaning naa rei nge maw a chah vy maw? Khazing a rei nge maw a chah vy?
Kaaning cawh kaa hmuhpaw le kaa thuipaw heh rei lytah ung khy bei peh,” tatah aa palei he.

Lesá tah aa pachih khy tai he tah Piter le Johan cawh aa thlaw he. Zehapaw dangtahnah maw kaa pae he tahpaw khah bia cheh khy bei he. Zecawtamaw tatah cawngsaw vytei tah a phesongpaw cung letei a tlungpaw hming aa hmuhpaw thong tei Khazing aa reithaipaw khah aa hmuh cawtah a cang.
A phesongpaw, khuarawha chuipaw tei dangnah a hmuhpaw cawh kung songli hlui a tah ciapaw a cang.
Zingtu sahlo thlawchangnah
Aa thlaw taico he, Piter le Johan cawh zingtu a cangpaw he aa vesaw sahlo khaco a vaw he ka, tlangbui macang sahlo le macang sahlo tei aa tahnahpaw vytei he khah aa ching he.
Ma bia cawh aa thui tihtah Khazing khaco hmokheh teitah ma hrahei thlaw aa chang. “Vy Abuipaw Cungnungcai, alui le avai le rili le a chung letei a ungpaw maikaw heh nama tah na tua.
Kaa mapaw David, na saecapaw hmang khei Thlawpaw Pathai tah bia na rei,

content.text: ‘Zecawtamaw ma raang sahlo tahei aa thingae ka,
ma cawngsaw sahlo tahei a chahnai lypaw sadu heh aa thaw?
Alui letei siangpahrang sahlo tahei a pachia a paning he ka,
uhtu sahlo khakhei hmingkheh tah a pahmo he ka,
Abuipaw le Ama tei sathy a thupaw

content: tatah a tah.

Ma hraco Herod le Pontia Pilat tah Gental cawngsaw sahlo le Jerusalem khuapui letei a ungpaw Israel cawngsaw sahlo khakhei hmingkheh tah a pahmo he ka, Mesiah cawtah na thingpaw Zisu, na sae pathaipaw a carae pawtah aa reisia.
Aa tuapaw heh na thinglung le na hming tua khy ná tei naw na tlah khuipaw he le a cang hlai taitei cang tae seh, na tahpaw khah a cang.
Macawtaco Abuipaw, aa ma pachihnah sahlo heh pacang tua la, na sae sahlo heh raechah ngetei tah na bia ma reisah tua.
Na sae a pathaipaw Zisu ming tah dang nápawtah na bang pazy la, ningang chuipaw paching pakhanah le khuarawhanah tuá tua,” aa tah.
Thlaw aa chang khy taico, aa ungnahpaw hminghmaw cawh a calawh. Taico aa zongmingtei co Thlawpaw Pathai tah chih he ka, Khazing bia khah raechah teitah aa rei.
Zingtu sahlo tah aa cho a hrong he
A zingtu vytei cawh lungthing hmokheh teitah aa ung. Aa hnuicho khah ka tei a cang tatah ahotahmai tah ly he tah aa hnuipaw maikaw khah a hrong he.
Hmingtuakhynah a rungnawpaw khakhei apostol sahlo taco Abuipaw Zisu a thokawnah kong cawh reilai longmang he ka, Khazing ningdonah cawh aa zongmingtei cung lekhei a ung.
Aa hrong letah vainge tah ahohmai ung bei he. Aaning chung letei ing maw a cang ly leh ly maw a hnuipaw sahlo takhei ma sahlo cawh ato le ato zua he ka, a mai cawh va chuakhui he ka,
apostol sahlo aa phehrang lekhei chia he ka, a phahlahpaw cawngsaw khah aa rai he.

Saipras tuiraw letei Levi mingphing a cangpaw Josef, apostol sahlo tei Barnaba aa tahpaw (A silang cawh thawzaang peitu sawcapaw tahnah a cang) takhei, a hnuipaw baily khah zua ka, a mai tangka cawh va chuakhui ka, apostol sahlo aa phehrang leco a chia.

footnotes.text: Ma heh, Khri a cang ly leh Mesiah,tahnah a cang.
